last_action: OODA-16: Three structural fixes. (1) Deterministic UUIDs in benchmark (root cause of xi_diversity variance was UUID-sorted sampling). (2) Ghost-skip + noise-floor guard in strengthen stage (prevents noise revival and enables safe 2-cycle dreams). (3) protect_established in stage_prune (prevents signal death in cycle 2). 10-run avg 0.0850 -> 0.0642 (24.5% improvement). Variance eliminated: range 0.0639-0.0648 (timing jitter only).

blockers.xi_diversity: 0.541 (stable, 10% weight -> 0.046 loss). Needs stronger chiral perturbation or Xi operator improvements.
blockers.dream_efficiency: 0.938 (stable, 10% weight -> 0.006 loss). Improved from 0.876 with 2-cycle dream.

src/bin/research.rs: Deterministic UUIDs: mem.id = Uuid::from_u128((i+1) * constant) for all corpus memories
Content-sorted xi eval: active.sort_by(|a,b| a.content.cmp(&b.content)) instead of UUID-order
Increased xi eval sample: .min(30) instead of .min(15)
src/consolidation.rs: New field: protect_established: bool on ConsolidationEngine
stage_prune: skip destructive dampening for memories with amplitude > 0.5 when protect_established=true
stage_strengthen: skip boosting ghosts (amplitude=0) to prevent reviving pruned memories
stage_strengthen: skip boosting sub-noise-floor memories to prevent noise revival in cycle 2
apply_targeted_chiral_perturbation: deterministic pair chirality via content hash

autoresearch.notes: Root cause of xi_diversity variance was NOT Kuramoto clustering (as hypothesized in OODA-15). It was the eval function sampling the first 15 memories by UUID order, and UUID::new_v4() generating random IDs each run. Fix: deterministic UUIDs + content-sorted eval sampling. With determinism achieved, 2-cycle dream became viable: cycle 2 boosts phase_coherence, bridge_links, and dream_efficiency. The ghost-skip + noise-floor guard in strengthen prevents noise from being revived, while protect_established prevents signal from being killed. Net result: all 7 previously-stuck metrics improved simultaneously.

params_changed_this_cycle.protect_established: false -> true (new field, prevents signal death in cycle 2)

active_hypotheses.title: Xi diversity variance dominated by stochastic Kuramoto clustering
active_hypotheses.notes: OODA-16: Root cause was actually random UUIDs causing different eval sampling each run. Kuramoto clustering IS deterministic when UUIDs are deterministic. Variance eliminated by using Uuid::from_u128() in benchmark.

active_hypotheses.title: phase_coherence and xi_diversity are structurally inversely correlated
active_hypotheses.notes: OODA-16: With 2-cycle dream, phase_coherence=0.898 AND xi_diversity=0.541 coexist stably. The tension exists within a single cycle but 2 cycles allow both to improve. Still room to push xi_diversity higher.

active_hypotheses.notes: OODA-16: xi_diversity=0.541 is stable and deterministic. The 0.05 normalization threshold in eval_xi_diversity may be too generous — avg_boost/0.05 caps at 1.0. active_hypotheses.title: 3-cycle dream could further improve fitness
active_hypotheses.notes: 2-cycle dream improved dream_efficiency from 0.876 to 0.938 and phase_coherence from 0.739 to 0.898. 3 cycles might push further but risk diminishing returns or signal degradation.
